data.exact_reserve_text: During 2014 the Syndicate released GBP 77.4m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods, arising predominantly from the Marine, Property and Treaty Divisions (2013: GBP 79.4m, primarily from the Energy and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses in 2014.
specific_events: Hailstorm and tornado events in US (May/June 2014)

prior_year_events.impact_description: 2013 events including Tropical Storms Ingrid and Manuel that hit Mexico in September and various European weather events. The total net loss from each of these events is below GBP 10m.

named_events.loss_description: Hurricane Odile which struck the south-western coast of the US and Mexico in September. The total net loss from each of these events is below GBP 10m.
Very heavy snowfall in Japan in February. The total net loss from each of these events is below GBP 10m.

named_events.event_name: Hailstorm and tornado events in the US
named_events.loss_description: A number of hailstorm and tornado events in the US in May and June. The total net loss from each of these events is below GBP 10m.
Losses from Super Typhoon Haiyan in the Philippines noted by the report; contained within divisional catastrophe budgets.
Tragic loss of over 300 lives on the Sewol ferry in Korea; noted as a significant liability loss in 2014.
Further deterioration in the Costa Concordia loss was noted, though this remained comfortably within the reinsurance programme; removal of the wreck completed.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2014 the Syndicate recorded a net release of prior year technical reserves of GBP 77.4m (a reduction in gross claims outstanding), predominantly arising in the Marine, Property and Treaty divisions. The report attributes the release to favourable claims development on losses during 2014 and notes that a number of named natural catastrophe and weather-related events (heavy snowfall in Japan, US hail/tornado events, Hurricane Odile) produced net losses that were each below GBP 10m, contributing to contained reserve movements.
raw_causal_phrases: released GBP 77.4m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods
These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses in 2014.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Reserves reconciliation (gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2014 = GBP 1332.5m). Prior year development taken from Movement in prior year's provision narrative which explicitly states a gross release of GBP 77.4m; narrative appears to refer to gross technical reserves. No gross per-line prior year amounts were provided, only divisions named. A Reinsurance to Close (Acceptance of Syndicate 4000 RITC) is present in the technical reserves table which can distort development or triangle calculations; no gross claims development triangle was present in the notes to enable a cross-check. Divisional gross premium mix used (preferred divisional summary) rather than regulatory statutory classes. Some named event net loss amounts are described qualitatively ("below GBP 10m") and not quantified precisely; such values are left null.
